name: py-outline
purpose: Outline a Python file: its imports, classes, methods and functions with signatures, start and end lines, decorators and first doc line, so you read only the lines you need.
examples: what functions and classes are in this module
show the methods and signatures of a python file
where is the function defined and which lines does it span
list the definitions in a file before reading it

path.description: the Python file, relative to the worktree

symbol.description: only this class or function (Class.method for a method) and what it holds
